user.title: GamerPower Plus
user.description: Track free game giveaways from GamerPower.com. Platforms and types are queried from the API; the other settings are applied locally and can be changed later in the options.

data_description.name: Leave empty to generate it from the platforms and types, e.g. "Steam, Epic — game".
data_description.platforms: A giveaway matches if it is available on any of the selected platforms.
data_description.types: Game: full games, Loot: DLC and in-game items, Beta: early access and beta keys.
data_description.min_worth: Hide giveaways worth less than this amount in USD. 0 shows every giveaway.
data_description.include_no_worth: Keep giveaways whose worth is unknown (N/A).
data_description.exclude_keywords: Comma separated, case insensitive. Giveaways whose title contains any of them are hidden.
data_description.expiring_hours: "Expiring soon" turns on when a giveaway ends within this many hours.

reconfigure.title: Change platforms and types
reconfigure.description: Giveaways that are already active for the new selection will not be reported as new.

data_description.platforms: A giveaway matches if it is available on any of the selected platforms.
data_description.types: Game: full games, Loot: DLC and in-game items, Beta: early access and beta keys.
